claims.statement: Tom Allen and old Bill Ryall first came to America in 1868.
claims.excerpt: when old Bill Ryall and Tom Allen first came to this ‘‘blarsted’’ country

claims.statement: Ned Donnelly was Tom Allen's opponent in many mimic (sparring) encounters.
claims.excerpt: Ned Donnelly, Allen's opponent in many mimic encounters

claims.statement: Jem Mace wrote on March 13, 1876 that Joe Goss was coming to America principally to fight (the OCR reads 'fight / n', probably Allen), if a match could be arranged.
claims.excerpt: Goss is coming over, principally to fight / n, ifwecan geton

notes: Mace's letter to Coburn is garbled at the key word; 'probably Allen' is inferred from the hint and the context. The Coburn-Bauer wrestling proposal is not about Allen.
